senses.en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose
a show broadcast on television or radio
to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically

ex.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
ex.zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

ex.en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
ex.zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。

col: launch a programme｜启动一项计划
tip: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

senses.en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose.
To estimate a future amount or situation using current information.
To send light or images onto a surface.

ex.en: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
ex.zh: 我们的园艺项目是从三盆香草开始的。

ex.en: Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.
ex.zh: 研究人员预计，随着更多家庭改用电动汽车，电力需求将会增加。

col: carry out a project｜开展项目
be projected to rise｜预计会上升
tip: 名词重音在前，动词重音在后；音标按此顺序列出。

senses.en: to say firmly that you will do something
a firm statement that you will do something
signs that someone or something may succeed

ex.en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
ex.zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。

ex.en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。

col: promise to do something｜承诺做某事
tip: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

senses.en: To make the sounds of a word when speaking.
To state an official decision or judgment.

ex.en: Could you teach me how to pronounce your name?
ex.zh: 你能教我怎么读你的名字吗？

ex.en: Language learners often find unfamiliar sounds easier to pronounce after regular listening practice and feedback.
ex.zh: 经过规律的听力练习并获得反馈后，语言学习者往往会觉得陌生的音更容易发准。

col: pronounce someone innocent｜宣布某人无罪
tip: 名词是pronunciation，注意中间没有字母o。

senses.en: the way a word or language is spoken

ex.en: I practise my pronunciation by recording short voice messages.
ex.zh: 我通过录制简短的语音消息练习发音。

ex.en: Clear pronunciation helps language learners communicate effectively, even when their grammar is not always accurate.
ex.zh: 即使语法并非总是准确，清晰的发音也能帮助语言学习者有效沟通。

tip: 拼写是pronunciation，注意中间不是noun。

senses.en: In the correct or suitable way.
Completely or to the degree that is needed.

ex.en: The kitchen door will not close properly in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天厨房的门总是关不严。

ex.en: Public recycling schemes are more effective when residents understand how to sort household waste properly.
ex.zh: 当居民了解如何正确分类生活垃圾时，公共回收计划会更有效。

tip: 修饰动作常用properly；修饰名词用proper。

senses.en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

ex.en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
ex.zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。

ex.en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
ex.zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。

col: protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害
tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

senses.en: Feeling pleased about achievements or people you care about.
Believing you are better or more important than others.

ex.en: He felt proud of the cake he baked himself.
ex.zh: 他为自己亲手烤出的蛋糕感到自豪。

ex.en: Residents are often proud of their cultural heritage and support efforts to preserve historic buildings.
ex.zh: 居民往往为自己的文化遗产感到自豪，并支持保护历史建筑的行动。

col: proud to be｜以身为……而自豪
too proud to ask｜太好面子而不肯问
tip: be proud of后接名词或动名词，表示为……自豪。

senses.en: To give someone something they need or make it available.
To support someone financially by supplying what they need.

ex.en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
ex.zh: 营地为每位客人提供干净的毛巾和毯子。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。

col: provide access to｜提供使用……的机会
provide someone with something｜向某人提供某物
tip: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

senses.en: A place serving alcoholic drinks and often meals, especially in Britain.

ex.en: We had vegetable soup at the village pub.
ex.zh: 我们在村里的酒馆喝了蔬菜汤。

ex.en: In some rural communities, the local pub provides an important meeting place for residents.
ex.zh: 在一些乡村社区，当地酒馆为居民提供了重要的聚会场所。

tip: pub多见于英国语境，常供应餐食，不等于旅馆。

senses.en: For everyone to use, see, or know about.
Provided or controlled by the government.
Ordinary people in society considered as a group.

ex.en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
ex.zh: 这座公共花园每天开放到日落。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地上班，同时减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。

senses.en: to move something towards you or along by holding it
an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer
to injure a muscle by stretching it too much

ex.en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
ex.zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。

ex.en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
ex.zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。

col: pull a door open｜把门拉开
tip: pull是朝自己方向拉；push是向外推。

senses.en: A child who attends school.
The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.

ex.en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
ex.zh: 每个学生都带了一片树叶来上科学课。

ex.en: Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 小班教学可能让教师为每个学生提供更多个别指导和有用的反馈。

tip: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

senses.en: A young dog.

ex.en: The puppy fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
ex.zh: 小狗钻进我的空鞋子里睡着了。

ex.en: Adopting a puppy requires a long-term commitment to training, exercise, and regular veterinary care.
ex.zh: 领养幼犬意味着要长期承担训练、运动和定期兽医护理的责任。

col: a litter of puppies｜一窝幼犬
tip: 复数为puppies；通常专指幼犬。

senses.en: a small money holder; in American English, a handbag
money available to a person, organisation, or government
to press your lips together into a small rounded shape

ex.en: She opened her purse and took out a coin.
ex.zh: 她打开零钱包，取出一枚硬币。

ex.en: Investment in preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term burden on the public purse.
ex.zh: 投资预防性医疗可以减轻公共财政的长期负担。

tip: 英式purse多指零钱包，美式常指女式手提包。

senses.en: to press something or move it away by applying force
to strongly encourage or force someone to act
an act of pushing or a determined effort

ex.en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
ex.zh: 我来拿这些袋子，你能推一下手推车吗？

ex.en: Schools should encourage academic progress without pushing students to compete constantly with their classmates.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在学业上进步，而不是迫使他们不断与同学竞争。

col: push someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事
tip: push表示推，pull表示拉；push for意为力争。

senses.en: a loose top and trousers worn for sleeping

ex.en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
ex.zh: 我穿上睡衣裤，爬上了床。

ex.en: Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.
ex.zh: 选择舒适的睡衣裤并保持固定的就寝时间，可能有助于儿童养成更健康的睡眠习惯。

col: a pair of pyjamas｜一套睡衣裤
tip: 用复数；一套用a pair of；美式拼pajamas。

senses.en: How good or bad something is.
A characteristic of a person or thing.
Of a high standard.

ex.en: The quality of these shoes surprised me for the price.
ex.zh: 以这个价格来说，这双鞋的质量让我感到惊喜。

ex.en: Governments should improve the quality of public transport before encouraging people to give up driving.
ex.zh: 政府应先提高公共交通的质量，再鼓励人们放弃开车。

tip: 表示质量通常不可数；表示特质时可数。

senses.en: One of four equal parts of something.
A period of three months within a year.
An area of a town with a particular character.

ex.en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
ex.zh: 她把三明治切成四等份给孩子们吃。

ex.en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
ex.zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。

col: a quarter of an hour｜一刻钟
tip: a quarter of an hour是一刻钟；季度也是quarter。

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 女王从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，女王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

senses.en: with little or no noise
without attracting attention or making something widely known

ex.en: Please close the door quietly; the baby is sleeping.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门，宝宝正在睡觉。

ex.en: Students who work quietly in shared study areas help create an environment that supports concentration.
ex.zh: 在公共学习区域安静学习的学生有助于营造利于专注的环境。

tip: quietly是副词；注意别与quite（相当）混淆。

senses.en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely.
Completely or to the greatest possible degree.

ex.en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
ex.zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。

ex.en: Although cycling is quite popular among students, inadequate infrastructure prevents many commuters from choosing this sustainable option.
ex.zh: 虽然骑行在学生中颇受欢迎，但基础设施不足使许多通勤者无法选择这种可持续的出行方式。

tip: quite good常指相当好；quite impossible指完全不可能。

senses.en: A short test or game involving questions.
To test someone's knowledge or ask them detailed questions.

ex.en: We played a music quiz after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们玩了音乐知识问答游戏。

ex.en: A short quiz at the beginning of each lesson can help teachers identify gaps in students' understanding.
ex.zh: 每节课开始时的小测验可以帮助教师发现学生理解上的不足。

tip: 复数为quizzes；过去式为quizzed。

senses.en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest.
A social grouping based on perceived shared ancestry and physical characteristics.
To compete in speed or move very quickly.

ex.en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在桥上观看了划船比赛。

ex.en: Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.
ex.zh: 学校应确保所有儿童都享有平等的教育机会，不论其种族或家庭收入。

tip: race可指竞速比赛或种族；不要与民族混同。

senses.en: Tracks and services used by trains to transport people or goods.

ex.en: Our house overlooks the railway near the old bridge.
ex.zh: 从我们家能望见旧桥附近的铁路。

ex.en: Investment in railway networks can reduce road congestion while improving access to employment in neighbouring cities.
ex.zh: 投资铁路网络可以缓解道路拥堵，同时方便人们前往邻近城市就业。

tip: railway常用于英式英语，美式常用railroad。

senses.en: A coat that keeps your clothes dry in the rain.

ex.en: I grabbed my raincoat before stepping into the rain.
ex.zh: 走进雨中之前，我一把拿起了雨衣。

ex.en: Travellers visiting regions with unpredictable weather should carry a lightweight raincoat to stay comfortable during outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 前往天气多变地区的旅行者应携带轻便雨衣，以便在户外活动时保持舒适。

col: put on a raincoat｜穿上雨衣
tip: 英美英语都使用raincoat，并非仅限美式。

senses.en: to move something higher or increase its amount or level
to collect money for a particular purpose
to care for children or animals as they grow

ex.en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
ex.zh: 如果你还需要一支铅笔，请举手。

ex.en: Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 社区活动可以为自然保护项目筹集资金，同时帮助居民了解当地的环境问题。

tip: raise是及物动词，后接宾语；rise表示自身上升。

senses.en: to arrive at a place or achieve a particular level
to stretch out your arm towards something or touch it
the distance or extent over which something can act

ex.en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们刚到车站，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.
ex.zh: 政府若希望达到减少城市排放的目标，就必须投资公共交通。

tip: 表示到达时直接接地点：reach the station，不加at。

senses.en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines
A device that displays written material or reads stored information
A book designed to help learners develop reading skills

ex.en: An eager reader, Lina always carries a book.
ex.zh: 莉娜热爱阅读，总是随身带着一本书。

ex.en: Digital libraries allow readers in remote communities to access educational resources without travelling to larger towns.
ex.zh: 数字图书馆让偏远社区的读者无需前往较大的城镇，就能获取教育资源。

col: an avid reader｜热衷阅读的人
tip: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

senses.en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or provides.
To welcome someone arriving at a place.

ex.en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
ex.zh: 你收到我昨天发的照片了吗？

ex.en: All residents should receive clear information about changes to public transport before new routes are introduced.
ex.zh: 在新线路开通之前，所有居民都应获得有关公共交通调整的明确信息。

col: receive an email｜收到电子邮件
receive a warm welcome｜受到热烈欢迎
tip: receive侧重收到；accept侧重愿意接受。

senses.en: having happened or started a short time ago

ex.en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
ex.zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。

tip: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

senses.en: Not long ago, or during the period just before now.

ex.en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
ex.zh: 我们最近搬进了河边的一套公寓。

ex.en: Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员最近探讨了绿地的可及性如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 可用于一般过去时或现在完成时，不只限于完成时。

senses.en: the area where visitors are welcomed and given information
a formal social event held to welcome or celebrate someone
how well signals are received, or how people respond

ex.en: Please leave your room key at reception before breakfast.
ex.zh: 请在早餐前把房间钥匙留在前台。

ex.en: The proposal received a positive reception from local residents because it addressed their concerns about road safety.
ex.zh: 这项提议回应了当地居民对道路安全的担忧，因此获得了积极反响。

tip: 英式英语常说at reception，表示在接待处。

senses.en: Someone who welcomes visitors and handles enquiries at a reception desk.

ex.en: The receptionist smiled and handed us our room keys.
ex.zh: 接待员微笑着把房间钥匙递给了我们。

ex.en: A skilled receptionist can improve patients' experiences by managing appointments efficiently and responding calmly to enquiries.
ex.zh: 熟练的接待员能够高效安排预约、沉着回应咨询，从而改善患者的就诊体验。

col: work as a receptionist｜担任接待员
tip: reception 是接待处；receptionist 是接待员。

senses.en: Stored information about events, activities, or a person's history.
To store information, sounds, or images for future use.
The best result ever achieved in a particular activity.

ex.en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
ex.zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。

ex.en: Accurate medical records allow healthcare professionals to make informed decisions and avoid unnecessary treatments.
ex.zh: 准确的医疗记录让医护人员能够作出有依据的决定，避免不必要的治疗。

tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a device that captures sound, images, or information
a wooden or plastic wind instrument with finger holes
a person who keeps an official record

ex.en: I placed the recorder beside her before the interview.
ex.zh: 采访前，我把录音机放在她身旁。

ex.en: Using a digital recorder allows researchers to review interviews carefully and identify recurring themes.
ex.zh: 使用数字录音机使研究人员能够仔细回顾访谈，识别反复出现的主题。

tip: play the recorder指吹竖笛，不是播放录音机。

senses.en: sound or moving images saved for later listening or viewing
the process of saving sounds, images, or information

ex.en: We listened to a recording of birds during breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐时，我们听了一段鸟鸣录音。

ex.en: Access to a lecture recording allows students to review difficult concepts at their own pace.
ex.zh: 能够获取讲座录像，让学生可以按自己的节奏复习难懂的概念。

tip: 一段录音可数；表示录制过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: an appliance that keeps food and drinks cold

ex.en: Put the milk in the refrigerator before it spoils.
ex.zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱，免得变质。

ex.en: Replacing an old refrigerator with an efficient model can reduce household electricity consumption significantly.
ex.zh: 用节能型号替换旧冰箱，可以显著减少家庭用电量。

col: store food in the refrigerator｜把食物存放在冰箱里
tip: 日常口语常用fridge；freezer专指冷冻柜或冷冻室。

senses.en: to say that you will not do or accept something
unwanted waste material that people throw away

ex.en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
ex.zh: 不带上她最喜欢的蓝色雨伞，她就不肯走。

ex.en: Local authorities may refuse permission for developments that threaten wildlife habitats or increase flood risks.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能拒绝批准威胁野生动物栖息地或增加洪灾风险的开发项目。

col: refuse to do something｜拒绝做某事
tip: 名词读/ˈrefjuːs/；动词后接to do，不接doing。

senses.en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events.
Having an even shape, pattern, or arrangement.
Someone who often visits the same place.

ex.en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
ex.zh: 我们的狗需要经常散步，才能保持快乐和健康。

ex.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律运动可以降低老年人患慢性病的风险，并改善其整体身心健康。

col: at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间
tip: regular侧重规律或经常，不等于持续不停的continuous。

senses.en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other.
A connection between things or the way they affect each other.

ex.en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
ex.zh: 她和妹妹的关系很亲密。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

col: the relationship between A and B｜甲与乙之间的关系
tip: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

senses.en: money paid regularly to use someone else's property
to pay to use something owned by someone else
to let someone use your property in exchange for payment

ex.en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
ex.zh: 我每月的租金包含水费，但不含电费。

ex.en: Rising rents in urban areas can force essential workers to live further from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 城市地区租金上涨可能迫使提供基本服务的劳动者住得离工作地点更远。

col: rent out a room｜出租房间
tip: rent可指租入或出租；rent out明确表示出租。

senses.en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again
Work done to restore something damaged or broken
To improve a damaged relationship or put a situation right

ex.en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
ex.zh: 你能修好我夹克上坏掉的拉链吗？

ex.en: Encouraging consumers to repair household appliances rather than replace them could significantly reduce electronic waste.
ex.zh: 鼓励消费者维修而非更换家用电器，可以显著减少电子垃圾。

tip: 具体维修常用复数repairs；beyond repair表示无法修复。

senses.en: To take something's place or put something else in its place.
To put something back where it was before.

ex.en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我们需要换掉厨房里那把坏椅子。

ex.en: Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.
ex.zh: 如果政府充分投资基础设施和储能技术，可再生能源就可能逐步取代化石燃料。

tip: replace A with B是用B换掉A，别弄反方向。

senses.en: to answer someone or respond to a message
an answer given in speech or writing

ex.en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
ex.zh: 请在周五之前回复，好让我预订晚餐。

ex.en: Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.
ex.zh: 地方官员应及时答复对公共交通服务提出担忧的居民。

col: reply to a message｜回复消息
in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip: reply to后接人或消息，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: A spoken or written account giving information about something
To give information about an event or situation
To arrive somewhere and tell the person in charge

ex.en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
ex.zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。

ex.en: The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 这份报告指出，让居民更方便地使用绿地有益于他们的身心健康。

tip: report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.

ex.en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。

ex.en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
ex.zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。

tip: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。

senses.en: a room with toilets in a public place

ex.en: I stopped at the restroom before boarding the bus.
ex.zh: 上公交车前，我去了一趟洗手间。

ex.en: Providing a clean public restroom near busy transport hubs improves comfort for commuters and tourists alike.
ex.zh: 在繁忙的交通枢纽附近提供干净的公共洗手间，能让通勤者和游客都更加舒适。

tip: 美式英语中指公共厕所，不是普通的休息室。

senses.en: something that happens because of an action or event
the final score or outcome of a test or competition
to happen because of something or cause something to happen

ex.en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
ex.zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。

tip: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

senses.en: To go back, or give something back.
The act of coming or going back.
Money or benefits gained from an investment or activity.

ex.en: Please return these library books before you go away.
ex.zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资幼儿教育可以通过改善未来就业机会，带来可观的经济回报。

col: return to work｜重返工作岗位
tip: return已含“回”的意思，通常不再加back。

senses.en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger
to make a bell sound or cause one to sound
to contact someone by telephone

ex.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
ex.zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。

ex.en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
ex.zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。

col: give someone a ring｜给某人打电话
tip: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

senses.en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level.
To get up from sitting or lying down.
An increase in amount, level, or value.

ex.en: Warm air rises above the heater beside my desk.
ex.zh: 我书桌旁的暖气上方，热空气向上升腾。

ex.en: A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
ex.zh: 住房成本大幅上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬出去独立居住。

col: a rise in prices｜物价上涨
tip: rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。

senses.en: a machine programmed to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。

ex.en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
ex.zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。

tip: robot是可数名词；robotics指机器人学。

senses.en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface.
Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars.
Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。

ex.en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。

tip: rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。

senses.en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly
To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape
Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread

ex.en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
ex.zh: 橙子从桌上滚下来，滚到了我的椅子底下。

ex.en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
ex.zh: 工人把再生材料薄片卷成紧实的捆，以便储存和运输。

col: roll down a hill｜滚下山坡
roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子
tip: roll强调翻转滚动；卷起常用roll up。

senses.en: the top covering of a building or vehicle
to cover a building with a roof

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
ex.zh: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。

ex.en: Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 在屋顶安装太阳能板，可以帮助家庭降低电费并减少对环境的影响。

col: under one roof｜在同一屋檐下
tip: 复数是roofs；roof指外部屋顶，ceiling指室内天花板。

senses.en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems
past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased

ex.en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
ex.zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。

ex.en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
ex.zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。

col: a bunch of roses｜一束玫瑰
tip: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。

senses.en: shaped like a circle or ball
one stage in a repeated series of activities
around something or on all sides of it

ex.en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边放了一张圆桌。

ex.en: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 新一轮谈判可能有助于各国政府就减少工业排放达成协议。

col: a round of talks｜一轮会谈
walk round the lake｜绕湖散步
tip: round作介词常见于英式英语，美式多用around。

senses.en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products
a small object used to remove pencil marks

ex.en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry in puddles.
ex.zh: 这双橡胶靴让我踩水坑时双脚也不会湿。

ex.en: Recycling rubber from used tyres can reduce waste and provide material for safer playground surfaces.
ex.zh: 回收废旧轮胎中的橡胶可以减少废物，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。

tip: 橡胶不可数；橡皮擦可数，美式英语通常用eraser。

senses.en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them.
Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.

ex.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
ex.zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。

tip: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

senses.en: A bag carried on your back using shoulder straps.

ex.en: I packed my lunch and jacket in a rucksack.
ex.zh: 我把午餐和夹克装进了双肩背包。

ex.en: Travellers carrying only a rucksack can move more easily between public transport services.
ex.zh: 只背一个双肩包的旅行者换乘公共交通时行动更方便。

tip: 英式英语常用rucksack；不限定帆布材质。

senses.en: speaking or behaving without respect for others

ex.en: It was rude to interrupt her during dinner.
ex.zh: 吃晚饭时打断她说话很不礼貌。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to disagree respectfully without making rude comments about others.
ex.zh: 学校应该教孩子如何礼貌地表达不同意见，而不是对他人出言不逊。

tip: 对某人无礼用 rude to someone，不用 rude with。

senses.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required
control of a country or people by a leader or group
to govern a country or make an official legal decision

ex.en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
ex.zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。

ex.en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
ex.zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。

tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

senses.en: a person who runs, especially for exercise or in races

ex.en: A runner in bright shoes passed us by the lake.
ex.zh: 一位穿着亮色鞋子的跑步者在湖边从我们身旁跑过。

ex.en: Urban parks provide runners with safer exercise spaces away from heavy traffic and polluted main roads.
ex.zh: 城市公园为跑步者提供更安全的锻炼空间，远离繁忙交通和污染严重的主干道。

tip: run加-er时双写n；runner-up指亚军。

senses.en: the activity or sport of moving quickly on foot
the work of managing or operating something
flowing continuously or operating rather than stopped

ex.en: Running along the beach always clears my head.
ex.zh: 沿着海滩跑步总能让我头脑清醒。

ex.en: Local volunteers play a crucial role in the daily running of community sports centres.
ex.zh: 当地志愿者在社区体育中心的日常管理中发挥着关键作用。

tip: 表示跑步活动时不可数；the running of指管理。

senses.en: in a way that expresses unhappiness
used to express regret about an unfortunate situation

ex.en: He waved sadly as his best friend's train departed.
ex.zh: 最好的朋友乘坐的火车离站时，他难过地挥手告别。

ex.en: Sadly, many historic buildings have been demolished to make room for roads and commercial developments.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，许多历史建筑已被拆除，为道路和商业开发腾出空间。

tip: 句首Sadly常表示“遗憾的是”，修饰整句话。

senses.en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm.
Unlikely to fail or lead to loss.
A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.

ex.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
ex.zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。

col: keep someone safe｜保护某人安全
tip: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。

senses.en: The activity of travelling in a boat powered by wind.
A scheduled journey or departure by a ship or ferry.

ex.en: We went sailing on the lake last weekend.
ex.zh: 上周末我们去湖上玩帆船了。

ex.en: Sailing clubs can encourage outdoor exercise while teaching young people teamwork and respect for marine environments.
ex.zh: 帆船俱乐部能鼓励户外锻炼，同时培养年轻人的团队合作精神和对海洋环境的尊重。

tip: 运动义不可数；航班义可数，如daily sailings。

senses.en: A fixed regular payment for work, often expressed yearly

ex.en: Her new job offers a higher salary and shorter hours.
ex.zh: 她的新工作薪水更高，工时也更短。

ex.en: Although salary influences career choices, many graduates also value job security and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 虽然薪水会影响职业选择，但许多毕业生也重视工作保障和职业发展机会。

tip: salary指固定薪金；wages常指按时或按周计算的工资。

senses.en: the act of exchanging something for money
a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices
the amount sold or money earned from selling goods

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
ex.zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。

ex.en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

tip: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

senses.en: A man whose job is to sell goods or services.

ex.en: The salesman showed us how to fold the bicycle.
ex.zh: 那位男销售员向我们演示了如何折叠自行车。

ex.en: A skilled salesman should explain product limitations honestly rather than pressure customers into making unnecessary purchases.
ex.zh: 有技巧的销售员应如实解释产品的局限，而不是强迫顾客购买不必要的东西。

col: an experienced salesman｜经验丰富的销售员
tip: salesman明确指男性；不强调性别时用salesperson。

senses.en: Tiny loose grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts.
To make a surface smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper.

ex.en: The children built a castle from wet sand.
ex.zh: 孩子们用湿沙堆了一座城堡。

ex.en: Removing sand from riverbeds for construction can damage habitats and increase the risk of erosion.
ex.zh: 为建筑工程开采河床中的沙子可能破坏栖息地，并增加侵蚀风险。

tip: 表示沙子时不可数；一粒沙用a grain of sand。

senses.en: A light shoe with straps that leaves much of the foot uncovered.

ex.en: A small stone got stuck inside my sandal.
ex.zh: 一颗小石子卡进了我的凉鞋里。

ex.en: In warm climates, sandals are popular because their open design allows air to circulate around the feet.
ex.zh: 在气候温暖的地区，凉鞋很受欢迎，因为其开放式设计能让脚部通风。

col: a pair of sandals｜一双凉鞋
tip: 单只用sandal，一双用a pair of sandals。

senses.en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.

ex.en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这种番茄酱汁配新鲜意面很好吃。

ex.en: Preparing sauce at home allows families to control the amount of salt and sugar in their meals.
ex.zh: 在家制作酱汁，能让家庭控制饭菜中的盐和糖含量。

tip: sauce泛指酱汁；酱油应说soy sauce。

senses.en: finely chopped meat enclosed in a thin, tube-shaped skin

ex.en: We grilled sausages and served them with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们烤了香肠，配上新鲜蔬菜端上桌。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly choosing vegetarian sausages as they seek alternatives to traditional meat products.
ex.zh: 随着消费者寻找传统肉制品的替代品，越来越多人开始选择素香肠。

tip: 单根香肠可数；sausage meat指香肠肉馅，不可数。

senses.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.
To use less of something or keep money for later.
To keep something for future use, especially computer data.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
ex.zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。

tip: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。

senses.en: a tool with a toothed blade for cutting hard materials
cut something using a saw
past tense of see: noticed or looked at something

ex.en: He used a saw to cut the wooden shelf.
ex.zh: 他用锯子切割那块木制搁板。

ex.en: The last decade saw significant improvements in public transport, particularly in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 过去十年，公共交通取得了显著改善，尤其是在快速发展的城市地区。

col: saw something in half｜把某物锯成两半
tip: 表“锯”的过去式为sawed；表“看见”则是see的过去式。

senses.en: Feeling afraid of something or worried that something bad might happen.

ex.en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
ex.zh: 小狗听到雷声时显得很害怕。

ex.en: Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.
ex.zh: 害怕犯错的学生可能会在外语课上避免开口。

tip: scared形容感到害怕；scary形容令人害怕。

senses.en: Cloth worn around the neck or head.

ex.en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。

ex.en: In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.
ex.zh: 在较寒冷的地区，当地织造的围巾既能体现传统手艺，又能提供必要的保暖。

col: wrap a scarf around your neck｜在脖子上围围巾
tip: 复数可用scarves或scarfs，前者更常见。

senses.en: Making someone feel afraid or nervous.

ex.en: That scary noise was just a branch against the window.
ex.zh: 那个吓人的声音只不过是树枝在碰窗户。

ex.en: Starting school can be scary for young children, so teachers should create a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 开始上学可能让年幼的孩子害怕，因此教师应营造友善的环境。

tip: scary形容事物吓人；scared形容人感到害怕。

senses.en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments

ex.en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
ex.zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。

ex.en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。

tip: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

senses.en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

ex.en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
ex.zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。

ex.en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
ex.zh: 幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。

col: a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀
tip: 通常用复数；一把剪刀说a pair of scissors。

senses.en: the points gained in a game, test, or competition
to gain points in a game, test, or competition
music written for a film or the written music itself

ex.en: My score improved after a week of practice.
ex.zh: 练习一周后，我的分数提高了。

ex.en: Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.
ex.zh: 考试分数能提供有用的信息，却无法全面反映学生的创造力或实践技能。

tip: score可作名词或动词；score a goal指进球得分。

senses.en: A country in the northern part of Great Britain.

ex.en: We explored old castles during our holiday in Scotland.
ex.zh: 我们在苏格兰度假时游览了古老的城堡。

ex.en: Scotland attracts visitors with its dramatic landscapes, while rural communities benefit from spending on accommodation and local services.
ex.zh: 苏格兰以壮丽的风景吸引游客，而乡村社区则受益于游客在住宿和当地服务上的消费。

col: the west coast of Scotland｜苏格兰西海岸
a trip to Scotland｜苏格兰之旅
tip: 苏格兰是英国的组成部分；形容词通常用Scottish。

senses.en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear.
To check people or things for problems or suitability.
To show a film or programme to an audience.

ex.en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
ex.zh: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。

ex.en: Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.
ex.zh: 医疗服务机构应定期对易患病患者进行筛查，在严重症状出现前发现疾病。

tip: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

senses.en: The area beside the sea, especially where people spend holidays
Located beside the sea, especially in a holiday area

ex.en: We spent the afternoon building sandcastles at the seaside.
ex.zh: 我们下午在海边堆沙堡。

ex.en: Seaside towns often depend on summer tourism, which can create unstable employment for local residents.
ex.zh: 海滨小镇往往依赖夏季旅游业，这可能使当地居民的就业不稳定。

tip: 名词常用 the seaside；表示“在海边”用 at。

senses.en: One of the main yearly periods with particular weather conditions.
A period when a particular activity or event usually happens.
Add salt, herbs, or spices to improve food's flavour.

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。

ex.en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
ex.zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。

tip: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

senses.en: Kept hidden from people who should not know.
Information known only to a limited group of people.
An important way of achieving a particular result.

ex.en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。

ex.en: Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.
ex.zh: 政府必须在信息保密的需要与公众的知情权之间取得平衡。

col: the secret to success｜成功的秘诀
tip: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication.

senses.zh: 协会或组织的书记；干事
senses.en: An official managing an organisation's records and routine business.
A senior government official responsible for a particular department.

ex.en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。

ex.en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。

tip: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

senses.en: To appear to be a certain way.

ex.en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
ex.zh: 你走了那么远的路回家，看起来很累。

ex.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.
ex.zh: 尽管网络课程似乎很方便，一些学习者仍能从与老师和同学的直接互动中获益更多。

tip: 常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。

senses.en: A photograph you take of yourself, usually with a phone.

ex.en: We took a selfie beside the lake after our walk.
ex.zh: 散步后，我们在湖边拍了一张自拍照。

ex.en: Sharing a selfie online can express personal identity, but users should consider their privacy settings first.
ex.zh: 在网上分享自拍照可以展现个人身份，但用户应先考虑隐私设置。

tip: 拍自拍照用take a selfie，不用make a selfie。

senses.en: causing harm or requiring careful attention
not joking, or thinking carefully about something

ex.en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
ex.zh: 漏水的管道给我们的厨房造成了严重损坏。

ex.en: Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 空气污染仍然严重威胁着公众健康，在人口稠密的城市尤其如此。

col: take something seriously｜认真对待某事
tip: serious about 后接名词或动名词，表示认真对待。

senses.en: To give food or drink, or assist customers.
To work for people, an organisation, or your country.
To be used for a particular purpose.

ex.en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应新鲜的汤和温热的面包。

ex.en: Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆是社区活动空间，居民可以在那里获取信息、参加工作坊并结识其他学习者。

tip: serve as后接角色或用途；serve for不这样用。

senses.en: Help or useful work provided for people or customers.
Check and repair a vehicle or machine to keep it working.
A formal religious ceremony.

ex.en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。

ex.en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
ex.zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。

tip: 表示服务质量常不可数；各项服务可用复数。

senses.en: Put something somewhere, or establish a condition, value, or rule.
A group of related things that belong together.
Fixed or arranged in advance.

ex.en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 她把碗轻轻放在厨房的桌子上。

ex.en: Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
ex.zh: 政府应设定明确的空气污染减排目标，并定期评估实现这些目标的进展。

col: a set of tools｜一套工具
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为set；现在分词为setting。

senses.en: Coming after sixth and before eighth in an ordered sequence.
One of seven equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our new flat is on the seventh floor.
ex.zh: 我们的新公寓在七楼。

ex.en: By the seventh week of the course, students were able to analyse basic scientific data independently.
ex.zh: 到课程第七周时，学生已能独立分析基本的科学数据。

tip: 序数词前通常用the；已有物主限定词时不用the。

senses.en: More than two but not many
A few people or things already mentioned or understood

ex.en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
ex.zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。

ex.en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: several of them｜他们中的几个
for several reasons｜出于几个原因
tip: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

senses.en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement
to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence
a quick movement back and forth

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
ex.zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。

ex.en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

tip: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

senses.en: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something.
Used with I or we to express future intentions formally.
Used in formal rules to state a requirement.

ex.en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
ex.zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？

ex.en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
ex.zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。

tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；Shall we常用于提议。

senses.en: a liquid product used to wash hair
to wash hair using shampoo

ex.en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
ex.zh: 我为这次旅行装了一小瓶洗发水。

ex.en: Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.
ex.zh: 使用可补充装的洗发水容器可以减少家庭和旅游业产生的塑料垃圾。

col: a bottle of shampoo｜一瓶洗发水
shampoo your hair｜用洗发水洗头
tip: 泛指洗发水通常不可数；一瓶用a bottle of shampoo。
